connector.name: Ozor
connector.registryDescription: Generate AI videos from a prompt or document (PDF/PPTX/DOCX/URL) and export shareable MP4s.
connector.summary: Hosted at mcp.ozor.ai over streamable HTTP, also runs locally from the npm package ozor-mcp-server. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches all 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the mintii-labs account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: OZOR_API_KEY
env.description: Your Ozor API key (sk_live_...). Create one at https://ozor.ai under Settings → API Keys.

env.name: OZOR_BASE_URL
env.description: Override the Ozor API base URL (defaults to https://ozor.ai). Useful for staging.
